trust_decision.summary: The client-supplied IIIF Auth 2.0 'origin' is trusted verbatim as a CSP frame-ancestors token and as the targetOrigin literal inside an inline <script>; the fix decides 'is this a well-formed scheme://host[:port] origin' at the REST login/token handlers and JS-escapes it in the token response body.

landing_point.why: Summary names 'IIIF Auth 2.0 origin parameter', 'CSP' and 'reflected XSS'; the only class with @QueryParam("origin"), the CSP header and the postMessage script builder is AuthorizationFlowResource.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/v2/auth/login?origin= (loginService): origin -> session, redirect URI, CSP header
GET /api/v2/auth/token?messageId=&origin= (accessTokenService): origin -> CSP header via generateOkResponse
GET /api/v2/auth/token (getTokenServiceResponseBody): origin -> single-quoted JS string in inline script
fix_sites.module_kind: private HTML/JS response builder in same handler class

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Published fix touches only AuthorizationFlowResource.java (fix.diff:199-519); commit 7e5e9de (fix.diff:1-193) is an unrelated SearchBean/subtheme change bundled in the advisory's commit list.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: messageId is 'already JSON-serialized by Jackson so it is safe', and the logincomplete page is 'a JSF view, not the IIIF Auth REST API the report names', so a solver confines validation/escaping to the origin query parameter in AuthorizationFlowResource.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate origins with ports, punycode or IPv6 literals must still be accepted and echoed into CSP/postMessage; the token endpoint must still return an INVALID_REQUEST postMessage page when origin is empty; the jsonMsg payload must stay valid JSON (escaping the whole body with a JS-string escaper or HTML-encoding it breaks the client's postMessage parsing).

O6_input_shapes: origin query param with a single quote / </script> breaking the JS string (token endpoint body)
origin with spaces, semicolons or extra CSP source tokens (CSP header malformation on login and token)
origin with path/query/userinfo instead of bare scheme://host[:port]
empty origin on token endpoint (allowed through, escaped to empty string)

O7_producer.where: goobi-viewer-core/src/main/java/io/goobi/viewer/controller/JsonTools.java:76-82,171-172 (plain Jackson ObjectMapper, no HTML/script char escaping) produces jsonMsg that is concatenated raw into the <script> at AuthorizationFlowResource.java:218-219

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Client messageId is serialized into AuthAccessToken2/AuthAccessTokenError2 JSON and appended unescaped inside the same inline <script> as origin; fix escapes only origin.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is JSON produced by Jackson, not string concatenation, and the advisory names only the origin parameter.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file and method as the landing point; producer in controller/JsonTools.java

O8_uncovered_routes.route: IIIF login tab: ?origin= on /login/ is bound unvalidated into UserBean.origin (session bean) and later rendered inside a single-quoted JS string on /logincomplete/ after login.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a JSF page and managed bean, not the IIIF Auth REST endpoint; loginService (now validated) is the normal producer of that URL; Facelets EL output is assumed to be auto-escaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other module kind and package: login.xhtml:17-19 -> managedbeans/UserBean.java:1083-1086 (no check, while setRedirectUrl right above validates at UserBean.java:1069-1074) -> logincomplete.xhtml:12; reached via redirect at UserBean.java:396-398,444-446

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Probe GET endpoints pass the request Origin header unvalidated into generateOkResponse, which emits it into the Content-Security-Policy header.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Origin header is browser-set and not attacker-chosen cross-site; probe responses are JSON, not framed HTML.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; five entry points at AuthorizationFlowResource.java:353,424,465,528,596

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A IIIF Auth 2.0 logout or per-service HTML page reusing generateOkResponse with a query-param origin.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: generateOkResponse is the shared response helper that already carries origin into CSP; a new HTML endpoint would naturally reuse it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Origin also forwarded through OpenID/external auth provider callbacks that end on logincomplete.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: isCloseTabAfterLogin keys only off UserBean.origin (UserBean.java:905-907), so any provider callback ending a login would hit the same page.

O9_family: Output encoding / injection into HTTP header (CSP token) and inline JS context (reflected XSS)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven (goobi-viewer-core/pom.xml:63 maven.compiler.release 21; Jersey JAX-RS, Jakarta Faces)
services: servlet container for end-to-end; Solr/DB not needed for unit tests of AuthorizationFlowResource helpers
O10_build.project_tests: No test for AuthorizationFlowResource at the pinned commit (no files under goobi-viewer-core/src/test/java/io/goobi/viewer/api/rest/v2/auth/); UserBeanTest exists at goobi-viewer-core/src/test/java/io/goobi/viewer/managedbeans/UserBeanTest.java. Fix diff adds no tests.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an origin regex check in loginService/accessTokenService and escape origin in getTokenServiceResponseBody, leaving messageId JSON, the probe Origin header and UserBean/logincomplete untouched.
